name: Nutrien
description: Global fertilizer producer that produces and upgrades nitrogen at 11 strategically located facilities in Canada and the United States plus one in Trinidad; it reports a combined annual gross ammonia nameplate capacity of more than seven million tonnes and supplies about 5 million tonnes of fertilizer products to customers in more than 50 countries.

sources.note: Nutrien nitrogen business page (more than 7 Mt/yr gross ammonia nameplate, 11 nitrogen facilities in Canada and the US plus Trinidad, product slate), read 2026-11-17

notes: Headquarters city is not stated on the page read; country recorded from the Canadian producer's own site.
